notes: The horizontal rule under the text block runs right through the last line of names (".xperia .xxx .xyz .yachts ... .zw"), cutting their descenders. Move the rule down so it clears the text.

The hollow names such as ".afamilycompany" at the end of the first row and ".bentley" or ".bananarepublic" further down are pale outlines that almost vanish against the background. Give them more contrast.

Several registry colours are too close to tell apart in small text, for example the red of Binky Moon, the magenta of Identity Digital and the purple of Registry Services (compare ".archi" with ".casa" in row three). Choose hues that are further apart.

The struck-through names are light grey with a grey line through them, for example ".abarth" in the first row and ".volkswagen" near the bottom, which makes them nearly invisible. Give them more contrast or use a mark that leaves the letters legible.

In the Arabic rows near the bottom, for example the line that starts "السعودية .پارت .سودان", the monospace font falls back to a different face. The leading dots also land on the wrong side of the names, so the rows look broken. Isolate each RTL name so its dot stays with it.
